title: Does Regularizing Fluoxetine Intake Time Improve Depression Symptoms? A Single-Subject Study

contributions.purpose: 检验规律化氟西汀服药时间是否改善单被试抑郁症状
contributions.mechanism: 单被试 N-of-1 观察设计:比较不规律期(2025-03-17至03-31)与规律期(2025-04-01至05-15)的每日中位情绪/精力与每周 BDI-II,配 bootstrap CI 与置换检验
contributions.evaluation: 服药规律性确认(circular SD 0.87→0.39 rad),但情绪反而下降(差 -0.46,Hedges g -0.59,置换 p=0.095),精力几乎不变(差 -0.08,p=0.809)
contributions.domain: 精神药理 / N-of-1 自我追踪研究
contributions.source_quote: Contrary to the hypothesis, daily mood was lower during regularization (mean difference -0.46; Hedges g -0.59, 95% CI [-1.68, 0.30]; permutation p=0.095).

contributions.purpose: 评估探索性结局 BDI-II 的变化
contributions.mechanism: 对规律期前后 BDI-II 均值做 bootstrap CI 前后对比
contributions.evaluation: BDI-II 反而升高(27.0→30.8,均值差 +3.8),即症状未改善;结论:仅规律化服药时间不足以改善症状
contributions.source_quote: Exploratory BDI-II increased from 27.0 to 30.8 (mean difference +3.8). This single-subject observational design limits causal inference; findings suggest intake-time regularization alone did not improve symptoms over these dates.

notes: 典型负结果论文:规律化服药时间未改善情绪/精力,BDI-II 反升(+3.8),情绪反降(g -0.59);作者明确承认单被试观察设计限制因果推断、样本小、有混杂(睡眠/季节/日常)。论文本身由 AI agent 主导写作与分析(Responsible AI Statement,checklist 全 D)。四元组适配良好,两条均 finding。decision=reject。
